objective: Increase average basket size by 15% among active Southwest loyalty members purchasing grilling-related products (beef, pork, seafood, marinades, charcoal) between June 1 and August 31, 2026.

target_market.description: Active Vons/Albertsons loyalty members in the Southwest and Pacific divisions who have purchased any grilling-related product in the past 12 months, with household size 2+, outdoor lifestyle indicators, and digital enrollment.

messaging_pillars: Summer's best meals start with the best ingredients — our premium cuts at unbeatable prices
Exclusive loyalty member savings on everything you need for the perfect backyard cookout
From the grill to the table in under 30 minutes — chef-quality seafood and beef made easy
creative_brief_summary: Create 3 EMAIL send sequences (weeks 1, 4, 8) and a PAID_SOCIAL carousel series targeting active loyalty members in the Southwest. Two creative tracks: (1) Red Meat & BBQ essentials featuring premium cuts with loyalty price callouts, (2) Fresh Seafood & lighter grilling options. All assets must use real food photography (no lifestyle/people-only shots per past lesson). Email sends scheduled Thursday. Each email variant must include a personalized loyalty member savings badge.
risks: Seafood subcategory historically underperforms without dedicated creative — mitigate by building separate asset track
Paid social CPMs typically spike 20-30% during Memorial Day and 4th of July — monitor daily budget pacing and cap bids at $12 CPM
Email deliverability risk if batch too large — segment into 4 weekly cohorts for Southwest region sends
rationale: The Southwest and Pacific divisions have the highest grilling product penetration in the Albertsons network (index 142 vs national) and Vons banner loyalty members show 2.3× higher lifetime value in the meat/seafood category versus non-loyalty shoppers. EMAIL+PAID_SOCIAL channel mix reflects the digital enrollment rate (78%) of target segment and allows precise loyalty member targeting without wasted impressions. 55/45 EMAIL/PAID_SOCIAL split optimizes for low-cost touchpoints first (email CPM ~$1.20) while PAID_SOCIAL drives incremental reach among digital-first members who open email less frequently. Budget of $500K total is appropriate for a 90-day 500-store regional campaign at the target reach of 1.2M households.
